pages.title: What The Surface Lacks
pages.text: Everything above ground is wood, stone, crops and magic. The things that $(o)do not belong$() in a world like this are buried in it.$(br2)Gems. Gunpowder. Machinery nobody up here could have built. The further down you dig, the less the world explains itself.

pages.title: The Deeper, The Stranger
pages.text: Depth is the progression. Not a tech tree, not a quest list - just how far down you are willing to go, and what you can survive once you are there.$(br2)Bring light, bring food, and expect the walk home to be the hard part.
